title: Rename Theme To Appearance
description:
Rename the light/dark/system UI appearance concept from "theme" to "appearance" across the whole repo, without leaving any leftovers. This is scoped strictly to the light/dark/system toggle concept (ElementsSurfaceTheme, uiTheme storage key, DOM data attribute, settings panel labels/ids, Rust WindowInput.theme, sketchpad translation schema, os-shell.tsx settings host). Do NOT touch the unrelated "design theme"/color-palette concept (BoardTheme, CanvasTheme, ChromeTheme, MapTheme, StylingThemeName, Tailwind @theme, LaTeX theme=light|dark doc option, InteractionSpatialViewTheme) — that is a distinct, legitimate concept and must stay named "theme".

Files known to be in scope (from prior research):
- ui/js/react/index.tsx: ElementsSurfaceTheme type, resolveElementsSurfaceChromeDark, applyElementsSurfaceChromeThemeDom, bootstrapElementsSurfaceChromeDocument, useElementsSurfaceChrome theme param, dataset.uiTheme, UI_CHROME_THEME_STORAGE_KEY ("ui.chrome.theme"), readStoredUiChromeTheme/writeStoredUiChromeTheme, UiTranslationSchema settings.tab.theme / settings.theme (EN+DE), and related tests.
- framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx: uiTheme/setUiTheme state, SettingsHostApi.theme, "framework.settings.theme" id, ui.settings.tab.theme / ui.settings.theme.* label keys.
- framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs: theme_id field, ThemeSelect variant, "framework.settings.theme" / "setTheme" / "shell.theme." string literals (careful: this file also has an unrelated Theme color-token struct used pervasively — do not touch that usage).
- framework/core/rs/lib.rs: pub struct Theme { pub mode: String } and WindowInput.theme field (plugin contract).
- compose/client/lib/sketchpad/js/index.ts: 14 duplicated translation schema blocks with "theme" key (EN/DE) for settings panels.
- mit-bestand/präsentation/33.projektetage/js/index.ts: surfaceChrome: { theme: "dark" } call site.
- ui/styling/vite-elements-assets.ts: PLAYGROUND_PLAY_BOOT_THEME_SCRIPT constant + dataset.uiTheme assignment, and its test reference in ui/styling/js/index.test.ts.
- framework/renderer/react/components/world-3d-host.tsx: attributeFilter watching "data-theme"/"class".

Also fix the pre-existing mismatch where code sets `dataset.uiTheme` (producing attribute `data-ui-theme`) but some MutationObserver filters watch for `data-theme` — align these under the new "appearance" naming.

Rename all identifiers/strings/keys/attributes consistently: theme -> appearance, uiTheme -> uiAppearance, UI_CHROME_THEME_STORAGE_KEY value "ui.chrome.theme" -> "ui.chrome.appearance" (no migration/back-compat shim per repo rules — greenfield, no legacy support), ElementsSurfaceTheme -> ElementsSurfaceAppearance, settings.tab.theme -> settings.tab.appearance, settings.theme -> settings.appearance, "framework.settings.theme" -> "framework.settings.appearance", theme_id -> appearance_id, ThemeSelect -> AppearanceSelect, "shell.theme." -> "shell.appearance.", PLAYGROUND_PLAY_BOOT_THEME_SCRIPT -> PLAYGROUND_PLAY_BOOT_APPEARANCE_SCRIPT, Rust Theme struct/WindowInput.theme -> Appearance struct/WindowInput.appearance.

Do a final repo-wide grep pass for stray "theme" occurrences tied to this light/dark/system concept (excluding the design-token/color-palette Category B and the many unrelated German "Thema" hits under mit-bestand/recherche) to confirm zero leftovers before closing the ticket.
summary: Renamed the light/dark/system UI toggle concept from "theme" to "appearance" throughout the live source tree, leaving the distinct design-token/color-palette "theme" concept (BoardTheme, CanvasTheme, ChromeTheme, MapTheme, StylingThemeName, Tailwind @theme, LaTeX theme=light|dark, InteractionSpatialViewTheme) untouched. Renamed types/functions/constants/DOM attributes/localStorage keys/Rust structs/string literals/translation schema keys (EN+DE, including 14 duplicated blocks in the sketchpad translation schema) consistently to "appearance". Also fixed a latent bug where a MutationObserver watched a nonexistent "data-theme" attribute instead of the actual "data-ui-appearance" attribute. No migration/back-compat shim added (greenfield, no legacy support) — localStorage key literal changed from "ui.chrome.theme" to "ui.chrome.appearance" with no fallback read. Verified via cargo check (framework/core and wgpu crates) and bun typecheck (ui/js/react) — no new errors introduced; two independent full-repo grep sweeps (one upfront research pass, one final verification pass) confirm zero remaining "theme" references tied to the appearance-toggle concept in live source.
